_comment: Per-route payload ledger. Each number is a SOFT target; the HARD limit is soft × 1.03, computed by scripts/check-route-budget.mjs (HARD_HEADROOM_PCT) and not stored here, so a PR cannot widen its own room. Between soft and hard the docs build passes and warns. Past hard it fails (blocking in CI via docs-build). More than 5% under soft it fails as STALE. Change a number only with `npm run route-budget:rebaseline -- --reason "..."`, which also writes docs/route-budget.history.md; it lowers stale numbers on its own, and raises one only with --raise, after the owner's OK. Why: engineering/decisions/2026-09-29-route-budget-soft-hard.md. Origin of the ledger: engineering/decisions/2026-08-17-studio-dynamic-loading-audit.md §9.7.
_units: bytes. eagerJsGz = gzip(level 6) of every /_astro/*.js referenced in the route's HTML. htmlRaw = the HTML document itself.
